title: Charlson
summary: Assign the server's reviewed Charlson score using condition history on or before the index date. The existing category, hierarchy and weighting implementation is retained; this is not an age-adjusted variant or a lookback-limited score.

score_mapping_artifact.note: Vocabulary resolution uses the execution CDM. This checksum pins the integrated definition/weight source, not a database snapshot.

required_tables.conditional: Tables, value/unit/time roles and vocabulary required by the supplied index and other event bindings.

required_roles.index: person, event key, start; interval end according to index policy

limitations: See documentation for fixed policies, windows, missingness, coverage, tie order, output schema and analysis limitations.
